summary: Unpinned github: dependency resolves to attacker-mutable source at install time
details: package.json declares `"libsignal": "github:wanzchil/libsignal-node"` — an off-registry GitHub source with no commit SHA, no tag, and no integrity check. On `npm install`, npm clones whatever bytes the owner of that repository currently serves on the default branch and executes any lifecycle scripts bundled within, under the installer's user account. The dependency source is mutable at any time by the owning account, independent of this package's own published versions, so the content run on one install need not match the content run on another. The YARA `ping`/GET match in lib/Utils/generics.js is a weak keyword co-occurrence in a bundled utility file and is not corroborated by a concrete exfiltration path in the shipped code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
